subject.title: [BUG] drive list/info ignore pagination; info falsely reports File not found past page 1

question: Should `feishu_drive` `info` gain an explicit folder-scoped lookup contract, or should `info` remain root-only with users relying on paginated `list` for folders?
rationale: Current main proves the remaining bug is in `info`, but the safe fix changes the model-facing tool contract and must avoid unsupported root scanning for Feishu bot credentials.

options.title: Add scoped info lookup
options.body: Add optional `folder_token` to `info`, paginate `drive.file.list` only for that concrete folder, and update tests and skill docs for the new contract.

options.title: Keep info root-only
options.body: Leave `info` as documented root lookup, close or narrow this issue to docs, and tell users to use paginated `list` for shared folders.

options.title: Require live proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open without implementation until a maintainer or contributor can prove the intended folder lookup behavior in a real Feishu tenant.

recommendation.title: Add scoped info lookup
recommendation.body: Add optional `folder_token` to `info`, paginate `drive.file.list` only for that concrete folder, and update tests and skill docs for the new contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged list-half fix and the latest issue comment defining the remaining folder-aware follow-up boundary.
